# Camp Resource: Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 19, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Apr 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3bfcd97d731a468bace6e306425a7613~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Nothing beats a relaxing cigarette break, it's the doctors orders!

Generates Cigarette related items with a chance for chems.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine__

Image Credit: SugarBombsRADS/Nerevar/vc59755/Reasonable Madness

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f134f4cb2bc44677a64c8513e919fa07~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Cigarette Carton

Undamaged Cigarettes

Cigar Box

Preserved Cigarette Pack

Pack of Cigarettes

(Scrap for Asbestos, Cloth, Fiberglass, Plastic and Wood)

Chance for Chems

**Basic**

Buffout

Med-X

Mentats

Psycho

**Rare**

Berry Mentats

Grape Mentats

Orange Mentats

Buffats

Psychobuff

Psychotats

Daddy-O

DayTripper

Fury

Calmex

Overdrive

X-Cell

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

1x Gears

2x Springs

3x Steel

**Holds**

5 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
